title: Full Block Farmland and Dirt Path
description: This resource pack makes farmland be a full block rather than 1 pixel lower than regular blocks.
body:
The farmland block is 15/16 = 0.9375 blocks tall, allowing the player to see a block behind the farmland, even if that block has another block above it (see gallery). This resource pack changes the model of farmland to be a full block.
It does not change the hitbox, collision box or light interaction of farmland blocks.

There is also a release version available that does the same thing with dirt paths.

This resource pack is also available on CurseForge:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/full-block-farmland
